name: Strings of Fate
source:
Welcome to Strings of Fate. See the past by playing your grandma's violin, and through it mend the hurt town of Everfrost.

[Edited from [url=https://ingred46sisu.itch.io/strings-of-fate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到命运之弦。通过演奏祖母的小提琴来回顾过去，并通过它来修复受伤的永霜镇。

[编辑自[url=https://ingred46sisu.itch.io/strings-of-fate]itch.io[/url]]
